flows: sprite set: the menu offers casual | armor | As the story has it (checked); "armor" draws that set's sprite, reaches a second socket and survives a reload; "As the story has it" goes back
only where allowed: the sprite-set menu is offered only on the member with sets to switch between (never on one with none, never on a persona)
clear a pinned portrait: a portrait pinned from Rook's face draws it with Rook's bars; clearing it clears the page's own pin, and it stays cleared over a reload
